# Sportsbnb

> Book sports venues by the hour in Armenia. Find a court, pitch or pool near
> you, see live availability, and pay in the app in Armenian dram.

Sportsbnb is a sports venue booking marketplace based in Armenia, serving
Yerevan and other Armenian cities. Players search venues by sport, city and
price, pick an hour from live availability, and pay securely by card. Venue
owners list their facilities, set hourly rates and cancellation terms, manage
bookings, and are paid out from an internal ledger.

The site also hosts open pickup games that players can join, and teams players
can create or be invited to.

## Facts

- **Currency**: all prices and payments are in Armenian dram (AMD, ֏). Prices
  are quoted per hour.
- **Payment methods**: card (Visa, Mastercard), taken on the payment
  provider's own hosted page. Payment is taken in the app at the time of
  booking; there is no cash-on-arrival flow.
- **Platform fee**: none. Sportsbnb takes zero commission and adds nothing to
  the rate the venue owner sets. A venue listed at ֏10,000/hour costs the
  player ֏10,000, and the owner receives ֏10,000. The commission rate is a
  platform setting (`commission_bps`, currently 0) rather than a per-venue
  negotiation.
- **Holding a slot**: selecting a time creates a 20-minute hold. If payment is
  not completed in that window the hold expires and the slot returns to the
  calendar.
- **Cancellation**: set per venue by its owner. The default is a full refund up
  to 24 hours before the booking starts. Owners may instead choose a partial
  (50%) refund after that cut-off, or make bookings non-refundable. The terms
  that apply are shown before payment and stored with the booking.
- **Double booking**: prevented in the database by an exclusion constraint on
  the venue, court and time range, so two players cannot hold the same hour.
- **Sports a venue can be listed for**: football, basketball, tennis,
  swimming, volleyball, badminton, rugby, gym, cricket, golf, running and
  cycling. (Pickup games and teams can be organised around a wider set, but a
  bookable venue carries one of these twelve.)
- **Accounts**: booking requires an account. Browsing venues, games and teams
  does not.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what the platform does, search, featured venues.
- [Venues](/venues): browse and filter every listed venue. Accepts `q` (free
  text, matched against venue name, address and city), `sport`, `city` and
  `maxPrice` as query parameters — for example `/venues?sport=Football&q=Yerevan`.
- [Venue detail](/venue/{id}): one venue — photos, sports, amenities, hourly
  price, reviews, live availability and the booking panel.
- [Venues map](/venues/map): the same inventory on a map.
- [Nearby fields](/nearby): free public pitches submitted by the community.
  Not bookable; listed so people can find somewhere to play for nothing.
- [Games](/games): open pickup games with a date, time, sport, skill level and
  price per player.
- [Game detail](/game/{id}): one game — who is hosting, who has joined, where
  and when it is, and how to request a place.
- [Teams](/teams): public teams to join, and the form to create one.
- [Community](/community): players near you, activity and leaderboards.
- [For owners](/for-owners): how listing works, what it costs, how payouts
  run. The sign-up form behind it requires an account.
- [Blog](/blog): articles on venues, booking and the local sports scene.
- [About](/about): what Sportsbnb is and who runs it.
- [FAQ](/faq): the common questions, answered.
- [Contact](/contact): how to reach the team.

## Notes for machine readers

- The canonical host is `https://www.sportsbnb.org`. The apex domain redirects
  to it.
- Structured data is embedded as JSON-LD. `Organization`, `WebSite` and
  `WebApplication` are in the served HTML of every page and need no JavaScript.
  The rest — `SportsActivityLocation` with an hourly `Offer` in AMD on a venue
  page, `SportsEvent` on a game page, `FAQPage` on the FAQ, `BreadcrumbList`
  where there is a hierarchy — is injected on render, so a crawler that does
  not execute JavaScript will not see it. That is a known gap, not an
  oversight; the marketing and listing pages are prerendered with real text,
  the per-record pages are not yet.
- Account, checkout and payment pages are disallowed in `/robots.txt`. They
  contain nothing citable.
- This file is kept accurate deliberately. It previously stated that payments
  ran through Stripe, which was never true of the shipped product and is not
  true now: Stripe cannot serve Armenian businesses. Card payments are taken
  through a merchant-of-record provider, and the marketplace settles in dram.
